title.purpose: Retained earlier annotation heading step; current memory panel uses memory-title.

label.purpose: Standard buttons, card titles and tabs.

spatial-headline.purpose: Balanced clip heading above the paired evidence; scoped fluid scale with a phone override.

temporal-caption.purpose: Readable numbered description immediately below each temporal lane.

context-prose.purpose: Expanded action and subtask fields with a 75ch maximum measure.

memory-title.purpose: Current persistent scene-memory heading beside the update dot.

memory-entry-title.purpose: Object heading beside an observation dot and source timestamp.

memory-prose.purpose: Scoped side-column observation prose; grows to 0.81rem on phones.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove animation; collection previews also start paused.

motion.name: temporal-segment-hover
motion.purpose: Brightness 1.25 on temporal-segment hover; disabled by reduced motion.

motion.name: memory-observation-update
motion.purpose: At real forward timestamp crossings only: scale 1 to 1.65 and briefly brighten to #89efbb, then settle. Reduced motion removes the pulse.

narrative.overview:
The Evidence Gallery gives real human activity the largest, clearest surface. Cool dark neutrals recede behind authentic egocentric footage and hand-skeleton renderings. Restrained periwinkle identifies playback and selection. The personality is professional, precise and forward-looking; the source material supplies the visual variety.

The flat collection opens into a focused evidence view with synchronized video and spatial pose, timestamp lanes and calm annotation prose. Lavender and teal distinguish the two temporal levels; green marks memory observations. DM Sans, real video, low decoration and readable hierarchy remain the durable identity. The approved dark gallery replaces the previous pale canvas and permanent collection rail.
keyCharacteristics: Real video and synchronized meaning lead the hierarchy.
Cool dark tonal layers, a playback accent and distinct temporal color roles.
A flat collection and a focused enlarged episode.
One sans family, plain labels and tabular clocks.
Keyboard access, responsive stacking and reduced motion.

rules.name: The Playback Accent Rule
rules.body: Use periwinkle for playback, selection, focus or a primary action; do not turn it into a decorative category palette.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Lavender means subtask, teal means action, and green dots mean memory observations. Keep pose colors tied to their labelled tracks; pair every temporal color with numbers, timestamps, text and a visible playhead.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use DM Sans for identity, headings, labels and prose; reserve native monospace for clocks and sequence numbers.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate resting surfaces with tone, spacing and hairline borders; do not add floating card shadows to the gallery.

dos: Do let authentic video and source annotations supply the visual variety.
Do preserve the shared clock across cards, timelines, details and media switches.
Do keep complete memory and latest entries through the playhead visibly distinct.
Do preserve keyboard focus, responsive stacking and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep temporal colors, pose-track colors and timestamp-driven memory markers attached to their documented meanings.
donts: Don't restore the discarded permanent collection rail to this gallery surface.
Don't add decorative gradients, glowing accents, marketing KPI cards or shadows around videos.
Don't replace missing footage, pose channels or source annotations with invented evidence.
Don't rely on color alone for active time, selection or media availability.
Don't duplicate the memory title with a small heading above it or shrink prose to metadata size.
